source_and_symbol_owners.module_docstring:
Caller-valued practical progress from validated, currently satisfied facts.

The projection counts original requirement keys, never commands or files. It
returns cumulative credit, so losing a previously established fact produces the
ordinary signed loss at the controller rather than a hidden upward clamp.

declarations.expression:
"A commissioned child returns ONLY the parent's typed form. Fill report_update
inside this existing reasoning response. It describes your actual interpretation
of the supplied state BEFORE the selected next action. The result of a later tool
has not thereby been interpreted. At yielding, recorded fact fields describe
actual work, while interpretive fields retain their latest actual basis; prefer
actual assessment/annotation references where those express the requested meaning.
requested_report_purpose is the parent's actual information need. current_report_update
contains the latest admitted interpretation fields, initially the parent's supplied
initial values. Those initial values are not a new child judgment. Preserve their
declared meanings when revising the form; neither input chooses your scientific action.
"
declarations.name: REPORT_PROTOCOL

declarations.expression:
"On a fresh provider conversation, restored_episode_history is a bounded index
of your own actual prior decisions, not a generated scientific summary. Use the
ordinary episode.history tool when an older selected action, exact outcome or
admitted direct-child form matters. Its indices belong only to this Episode;
another Episode's same index names different work. A failed saved outcome stays
failed. Where the journal retained a pre-execution rejection, its status is
rejected and view=records supplies the original rejection_feedback separately
from an executed outcome. Reading history does not execute that work again.
A selected history read is one ordinary action with its actual zero or changed progress, while
automatic context restoration creates no completed action. Current report
values retain their actual current_report_basis_refs, not a later tool result.
"
declarations.name: HISTORY_PROTOCOL

declarations.expression:
'resource_tool_estimates, when supplied, describe expected execution time and
configured resources for the declared execution classes. Use these expectations
with your own yield estimate and prior outcomes to choose useful work. A timing
experiment earns monitoring credit for timing information learned and updates
execution expectations. Missing history means duration is unknown. Job elapsed
time and the duration of an own monitoring action are distinct measurements.
'
declarations.name: EXECUTION_EXPECTATIONS

declarations.expression: 'Do not execute native provider tools. The host executes your selected action.\n'

binding.expression:
"
Your internal decision may take several model exchanges. Return the required
closed response object. Use response_type=request_context to request your own
prior attempts through the declared lookup form. This only retrieves information
you already received; it does not perform new scientific work or complete an
action. After its decision_lookup_result arrives, continue the SAME decision.
Use request_context for own attempt metadata and selected inputs. Its
own_attempt_detail pointer addresses selected inputs, not their outputs. Use
the ordinary episode.history tool with view=records and selected
decision_indices to read exact previously received outcomes together. That
read is an ordinary action with its own completion observation; it does not
execute the historical actions or earn their old credit again. The reader
cannot access another episode's private history.
Use response_type=select_action with selection and report_update when ready to
dispatch an actual action. Only that action's actual completion supplies an
observation to your configured continuation controller.

decision_bootstrap supplies an authoritative scoped model state. decision_update
replaces the listed top-level fields and removes exactly removed_fields; omitted
fields keep their previous values. base_revision identifies the previous state
and revision identifies the resulting state. Newer state replaces older values,
including yield expectations; older estimates remain historical. A bootstrap
after conversation loss or compaction replaces earlier presentation state.
decision_lookup_result supplies only the requested own historical information.
Restored public exchanges preserve the requests and results of an unfinished
decision; do not repeat their already answered lookups merely to restore memory.

action_yields describes your OWN completed action categories. total_yield is
observed signed gain, excluding inherited credit. Expected category yield is
conditional on choosing and completing that category again; unavailable is not
zero. Approximate model bands are not calibrated next-outcome guarantees. Useful
evidence acquisition can have zero immediate credit when a later interpretation
earns the credit. Failed or unexecuted attempts have no completed-action gain.
Use recorded inputs and result references to distinguish specific prior attempts.
".strip()

binding.expression: ' Tool-specific and resource instructions are available through knowledge.search, knowledge.entry and knowledge.read. The tool_knowledge context identifies the run-frozen library. Retrieve sections when useful; these instructions do not select work, supply scientific evidence or add execution capabilities. Use the actual tool schemas and caller-owned configuration for execution. Knowledge reads use line coordinates, not scientific source-byte anchors. No manual read is mandatory.'

" Launch software/resource instructions have their own run-frozen library: launch.instructions.search, launch.instructions.entry, launch.instructions.read and launch.instructions.select. The launch_instruction_library context gives its identity. Select any relevant sections from one or several entries; pass the returned selection as launch_instructions in the child assignment. selected_launch_instructions contains exact sections already selected for this assignment. resource_launch_instructions contains the assigned resource's configured prompt, supplied automatically from this same frozen library; do not search for or select that prompt again. Instructions describe ways to work; they do not select resources, enable tools, override caller constraints, establish current availability or supply scientific evidence. Inventory and fresh observations remain separate. No instruction read or selection is mandatory."

binding.expression:
"A commissioned child returns ONLY the parent's typed form. Fill report_update
inside this existing reasoning response. It describes your actual interpretation
of the supplied state BEFORE the selected next action. The result of a later tool
has not thereby been interpreted. At yielding, recorded fact fields describe
actual work, while interpretive fields retain their latest actual basis; prefer
actual assessment/annotation references where those express the requested meaning.
requested_report_purpose is the parent's actual information need. current_report_update
contains the latest admitted interpretation fields, initially the parent's supplied
initial values. Those initial values are not a new child judgment. Preserve their
declared meanings when revising the form; neither input chooses your scientific action.
"

"On a fresh provider conversation, restored_episode_history is a bounded index
of your own actual prior decisions, not a generated scientific summary. Use the
ordinary episode.history tool when an older selected action, exact outcome or
admitted direct-child form matters. Its indices belong only to this Episode;
another Episode's same index names different work. A failed saved outcome stays
failed. Where the journal retained a pre-execution rejection, its status is
rejected and view=records supplies the original rejection_feedback separately
from an executed outcome. Reading history does not execute that work again.
A selected history read is one ordinary action with its actual zero or changed progress, while
automatic context restoration creates no completed action. Current report
values retain their actual current_report_basis_refs, not a later tool result.
"

'resource_tool_estimates, when supplied, describe expected execution time and
configured resources for the declared execution classes. Use these expectations
with your own yield estimate and prior outcomes to choose useful work. A timing
experiment earns monitoring credit for timing information learned and updates
execution expectations. Missing history means duration is unknown. Job elapsed
time and the duration of an own monitoring action are distinct measurements.
'
'Do not execute native provider tools. The host executes your selected action.\n'
